title: D3 pcpdaab — PDF resolver metadata (Administrative Appeals Board decisions)
description: One JSON per (row, lang) at output/d3/pcpdaab/{year}/{num}/pcpdaab_{year}_{num}_{lang}.json alongside a .pdf of the same stem. HKLII does not serve pcpdaab PDFs directly (its /static/ URLs return SPA HTML); the pcpdaab runner resolves each row against pcpd.org.hk's public decisions listing. See src/hklii_downloader/pcpdaab.py.

hklii.description: Metadata as scraped from HKLII's getother response.

anchor_text.description: Raw anchor text from the pcpd.org.hk decisions listing.

chinese_only.description: TRUE when HKLII lists this row under `en` but the linked PDF is Chinese-only ('This decision provides Chinese version only' marker). Trust this flag over the _en filename when determining actual language.

shares_pdf_with.description: Other AAB (year, num) partner tuples that share this PDF (batched decisions). Empty on all rows in the current corpus; the runner writes non-empty tuples when a single anchor spans multiple AAB numbers. See src/hklii_downloader/pcpdaab.py:60.

resolved_year.description: Canonical year parsed from anchor text (may differ from filename in edge cases).

resolved_num.description: Canonical decision number parsed from anchor text.
